deviations.impact: The backfill still inserts only the frozen 67 pre-cutoff chains and must not update or delete organic post-cutoff runs, events or states. At the verified snapshot, all ten organic runs are Skipped and have zero Paper orders and zero Live orders.

deviations.text: The approved contract incorrectly stated that the 402 primary rows and marker would cause no other database writes. Production has pre-existing enabled triggers on paper_orders, paper_fills, strategy_market_paper_runs, paper_positions and paper_position_settlements. Those triggers synchronously enqueue dashboard projection events for all five projected row types and copied-trader performance refresh work for orders, fills, positions and settlements; the running workers consume those queues and update derived state. Keep these normal schema side effects enabled and account for them explicitly rather than disabling or bypassing triggers.
deviations.impact: The backfill still directly writes only the exact 402 primary rows and one marker, but total physical database writes are greater and timing-dependent because existing workers may consume/coalesce queues during the one-second batch gaps. For the 67 completed chains, the five dashboard trigger paths imply 335 synchronous projection-event insertions before worker consumption. Copied-trader refresh queue writes are coalesced per wallet and therefore do not have a stable physical-row count. Read-only Production evidence confirms the triggers are enabled, their queues are now empty, four derived copied-trader performance rows exist, and both child dashboard lifetime projection states advanced. No trigger bypass, rollback or new Production mutation is authorized by this correction.
